storyFa: نجار سبز ابتدا طول تخته را از سر چپ اندازه می‌گیرد. بار دوم خط برش را با همان مبدأ دوباره بررسی و اصلاح می‌کند. سپس با یک اره در محلِ تأییدشده یک‌بار برش می‌زند و پاک‌کن کنار دستش یادآور خطای پیشگیری‌شده است.
meaningFa: پیش از کارِ برگشت‌ناپذیر، همان اندازه را دوباره از همان مبدأ بررسی کن.
fullGenerationPromptEnglish:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE complete finished PORTRAIT 2:3 illustration for an adult illustrated book of advice. Input Images 1 and 2 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets. Match their established character family and moderate hand-painted watercolor, but tell the entirely new story specified below. Do not copy their actual carpenter or bus stop.
Paint: overlapping translucent watercolor washes visibly inside heads, torsos, limbs and hands, with broad gentle irregular changes of pigment density, soft pooling and luminous textured white paper. Natural irregular edges, clean white paper margins on all four sides. Moderate layered watercolor, never uniform fine crystalline noise, marker, pencil, crayon, shiny 3D or flat vector.
All characters are adults with simple neutral medium-build bodies matching the references: neither chubby round torsos nor long skinny sticks. Heads are genuinely CIRCULAR, equal width and height, with no chin, jaw or flattened bottom; no necks, heads directly join shoulders. Subtle darker local-color contact shadow beneath head. Colored contours are a darker version of each body's own color, not black. Eyes are the same SMALL vertical dark ovals as the references, each with one tiny white glint INSIDE the dark oval, no white sclera around a pupil. Gentle brows and mouth, no noses, ears or hair. Blush, where present, is a faint diffused translucent rosy wash, never a hard round dot. If a character is female, add only two short fine curved lashes to the OUTER UPPER EDGE of the same small eye; do not enlarge or redesign eyes. All torsos neutral, no bust, pinched waist, hips, buttock emphasis or gendered bulges. Every fully visible hand has three fingers and one thumb, four digits TOTAL, naturally gripping objects. No extra limbs. Maintain identity and body color through all panels. Full bodies, feet, vehicles and essential objects safely inside frame. Gentle humane wit for adult readers, easy concrete visual cause and effect, no moralizing lecture.
Only the explicitly specified short Persian text may appear inside the image, joined Persian letters and correct RTL. No English, branding, watermarks, panel numbers, extra labels or long explanatory captions. Speech/thought bubbles must clearly belong to their speaker. Multi-panel reading is right-to-left for side-by-side panels, or top-to-bottom for stacked panels, with a narrow white gutter and no heavy comic borders.

Advice meaning: "Worth repeating: Measure twice, cut once." Show the two checks BEFORE exactly one irreversible cut.
Composition: PORTRAIT 2:3 art with THREE broad horizontal panels, top to bottom. Same workshop bench and the same GREEN adult wearing a plain cream apron in all three. All feet fit inside each panel. One single straight long wooden shelf board clamped to the bench extends horizontally across each scene. The board's leftmost end is the FIXED ZERO starting edge, and its right part is excess. Same viewpoint and orientation throughout; no other loose rulers, saws or offcuts.
TOP, first measurement: GREEN looks directly at the ruler marking, holding a straight steel ruler flat ALONG the shelf board from its LEFT ZERO END with one hand and making one thin pencil cross-cut mark with the other. The saw hangs safely unused on the wall. Small thought bubble «یه بار...». 
MIDDLE, second actual check: GREEN has physically repositioned and re-seated the SAME ruler carefully against the SAME left zero end, checking the very same intended shelf length. The ruler is parallel with the board, its reading and pencil mark clearly refer to the same location. GREEN leans closer with one eyebrow lifted and confirms the final thin straight cross-cut line using a small square. The first uncertain tiny pencil mark is being erased just beside the correct line, communicating that this check catches a slight error BEFORE any cut. No cutting tool touches the board. Thought bubble «یه بار دیگه...».
BOTTOM, one cut: ruler and pencil now laid to the back of the bench. GREEN uses ONE hand saw at the single confirmed straight cut line, board held securely by a vise and clamp. The saw blade crosses at that line, excess board supported, no impossible floating wood. Both hands and torso remain behind/outside the cutting path; cutting movement extends away from the torso. One modest fresh kerf and very few wood dust flecks, no multiple old cuts. GREEN's relieved small smile acknowledges the avoided mistake. Short bubble «حالا ببر!». Warm subtle humor: the unused big eraser is now resting like a tiny hero beside the pencil. No ruler numerals required; use simple ticks only. Exactly two measurement actions, then exactly one saw cut; no finished shelf installation or extra fourth panel.

Prioritize clear physical action and character consistency. In every panel the same adult green carpenter's complete round head, same body size and both feet fit inside its white margins. Keep the whole ruler flat against the SAME long board edge and measure the same shelf LENGTH twice, not two different dimensions. There is no cutting in the first two panels. The third panel has just one saw at the final marked cross-cut line, with no hands ahead of its blade. Faint diffuse cheek wash only. Match reference148 broad soft watercolor and reference131's small eyes. Keep workshop simple.

Final framing and continuity: THREE EQUALLY TALL horizontal panels in portrait 2:3. Same circular head diameter, neutral medium adult build, body height and limb thickness in every panel; complete feet and floor margin. Same board, same leftmost zero origin, same final cross-cut location. TOP measures shelf length from that left end, MIDDLE actually resets the ruler at that SAME left end and measures the SAME length again before cutting, BOTTOM cuts exactly once at the verified mark. In the bottom scene the free hand hangs safely outside the saw path. Broad layered watercolor, dark local green contours, no black body outline, no nose/ears/hair, tiny dark oval eyes with internal glint, no sclera. Visible hands exactly three fingers plus one thumb; grips may hide digits. Persian texts exactly as specified above. The portrait layout makes room for full bodies at consistent scale. No fourth panel or installed shelf.

qa.notes: دو سنجش واقعیِ طول از مبدأ چپ و یک برش دیده می‌شود؛ پاها کامل‌اند. تفاوت جزئی اندازهٔ سر بر اثر خم‌شدن و گونه‌های نسبتاً مشخص باقی است؛ همسانی پیکسلی یا محوشدن کامل گونه‌ها ادعا نمی‌شود.
qa.anatomyInspection: Open visible hands were inspected for three fingers plus one thumb; natural grips obscure some digits, so hidden digits are not counted. No pixel-exact anatomical or scale claim.
qa.styleInspection: Broad translucent body washes, dark local-color contours and small dark eyes with internal glints inspected. Generated texture and blush remain hand-painted approximations.

rootVisualReview.observationsFa: نسخهٔ عمودیِ واقعاً دیده‌شدهٔ ریشه عیناً استفاده شد؛ دو بررسی طول از مبدأ چپ و سپس یک برش در خط اصلاح‌شده خواناست. پاها اکنون در هر سه قاب داخل تصویرند. تفاوت جزئی اندازهٔ سر در اثر خم‌شدن و لکهٔ ملایم گونه موجود است، انطباق پیکسلی ادعا نمی‌شود.
